description: Step-by-step guide (Markdown) for fixing a problem the check found, for the site's platform when one exists (otherwise the general version). With consent_tool, returns the guide for wiring the Meta Pixel to that consent tool instead. Guides exist for: meta.fires_before_consent, meta.not_firing_after_consent, meta.duplicate_pixel, meta.missing_event_id, meta.fbc_not_set, and general.server_side_not_detected (setting up the Conversions API).

consent_tool.description: Consent tool guide: complianz (Complianz), cookiebot (Cookiebot), cookieyes (CookieYes), onetrust (OneTrust), usercentrics (Usercentrics)

issue_id.description: Problem id from a report, e.g. meta.fires_before_consent

platform.description: Site platform from the report, e.g. framer, shopify, webflow, wordpress

name: get_fix_guide
title: Get a step-by-step fix guide
